method.prepared_boundary: Released generated Java on prepared GenericRowData/BinaryRowData versus production Calc on matching Arrow. Operation and equivalent UTF-8 length/first/last-byte consumption timed inside Rust. Java uses BinaryStringData byteAt/getSizeInBytes without byte-array copying. Initial JNI/import/export and both perimeter transposes excluded; intrinsic previous JVM computation remains inside timing.
method.controls: Actual independently compiled preceding encoder must bind a JVM evaluator; candidate requires empty descriptors and intended native work. Same released modern/legacy cast mode configured before planning.
method.data: Nullable DECIMAL(18,2)/(38,18), signed extrema and large coefficients, NULL every seven rows. Modern v+v to STRING, modern v*v to CHAR(8), legacy (v+v)*v to CHAR(44). 1024-row bulk and 16-row modern v*v-to-STRING controls. NOT NULL arithmetic is excluded from this new signature and retains the preceding generated value/default/null-flag contract.
method.order: Serial paired processes; 16 warmups/nine measurements; 131072 rows/trial; equivalent consumption and matching checksums.
method.pipeline: Million-row nullable modern DECIMAL(18,2) v+v-to-STRING, modern DECIMAL(38,18) v*v-to-CHAR(8), legacy DECIMAL(38,18) (v+v)*v-to-CHAR(44); rowwise source/blackhole, parallelism one, two warmups/five measurements. Planning/startup, production JNI and both transposes retained; require consumed NativeCalc, no fallback, empty candidate descriptors.
method.allocation: Untimed CountingAllocator wrapping System with malloc=mi_malloc/free=sf_free aliases; JVM/C++/other-thread allocation excluded; counting disabled during timed trials. Requested bytes and output buffers are separate quantities.
